subject: Partner ambassador program — PromptSmith SDK co-build & tracehook plan
messages:
From: Jason Lee <jason.lee@promptsmith.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@promptsmith.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal — PromptSmithxRedwood ambassador co-build (SDK + tracehook)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro at the summit last month — PromptSmith loved the runtime benchmarks you shared. We discussed internally and would like to propose an "ambassador" style co-build: PromptSmith engineers + Redwood partner engineering work together to produce a first-class LangChain/LlamaIndex adapter that includes tracing hooks (we'd like Redwood's trace format) and an example prompt-tooling workflow.

High-level ask:
- Joint SOW for a 4-week pilot (engineering + QA + docs)
- Access to a Redwood sandbox environment and a short technical sync next week
- Agreement on tracing semantics and an example eval set we can use for regression checks

Are you the right person to coordinate? If not, please point us to the best lead on your side. Happy to share a draft SOW and our security questionnaire.

Thanks,
Jason
Co-Founder, PromptSmith

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Jason Lee <jason.lee@promptsmith.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — PromptSmithxRedwood ambassador co-build (SDK + tracehook)

Hi Jason — great to hear from you. Yes, this is something we want to pursue. Short answers up front: yes on the 4-week pilot, yes on a sandbox, and we can share our trace spec and a starter eval suite.

Next steps I propose:
1) Share your draft SOW + security questionnaire (we'll run it through partner security).
2) Technical sync: Tues 13 Apr 10am PT — invite to follow if that works.
3) Internal owners: Kimberly (PM) will own scoping, Mateo (partner eng) will own technical support. I'll coordinate partner commercial terms.

Kimberly/Mateo — can you review Jason's request and confirm team availability for a 4-week sprint and a Tuesday workshop?

I'll ask Legal to take an initial pass on the SOW once we have the draft.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — PromptSmithxRedwood ambassador co-build (SDK + tracehook)

Thanks Vanessa —
Quick internal notes:
- Mateo and I are available for a 4-week eng sprint starting week of Apr 19 (can compress if necessary).
- For the technical sync, we should ask PromptSmith to bring a short list of 3 integration scenarios (LangChain connector, LlamaIndex indexer, runtime trace export). That will help scope work and map deliverables to the SOW.
- I'll attach an internal integration checklist (integration-checklist-internal.xlsx) to use as a baseline for the pre-flight.

I'll coordinate a shared Slack channel once the HubSpot deal is created.

Kimberly Park
Product Manager, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Vanessa / team — attaching a short SOW (PS-Redwood-SOW-draft-v1.pdf) and our completed security questionnaire (PromptSmith-security-questionnaire-complete.xlsx). The SOW outlines a 4-week pilot: week 1 ramp + design, weeks 2–3 co-dev, week 4 QA + docs + sample eval.

Key commercial note: PromptSmith is requesting a small partner credit to cover initial infra consumption during the pilot; we'll capture that in the SOW and HubSpot.

Attachments: PS-Redwood-SOW-draft-v1.pdf; PromptSmith-security-questionnaire-complete.xlsx

Let us know if the files need to be uploaded to a secure share instead.

Thanks,
Jason

If you want, I can annotate the PDF and upload a redlined version to the Drive link. Otherwise, booked time on Tue 20 Apr if Legal needs a call.

Vanessa (follow-up): If you can confirm the Tuesday 13 Apr 10am PT technical sync, I will invite PromptSmith and include a short agenda.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — Tuesday 13 Apr 10:00am PT confirmed for the technical sync (calendar invite sent). Jason, I've uploaded the SOW and a short checklist to a shared Drive folder and added Marissa's note to the action items; we'll aim to have a redlined SOW by EOW after the sync.

Outstanding items for the sync:
- PromptSmith to present 3 integration scenarios (5–10 min each)

Looking forward to the workshop.

Best,
Vanessa
